# YTDLP Glass 1.0.0
- Native Apple Silicon media downloader with a Tahoe Liquid Glass interface. - Fixed quick-options bar, persistent download folders, and menu bar drag-and-drop downloads. - Bundled native Apple Silicon FFmpeg/FFprobe plus YouTube and Instagram compatibility improvements. - Fixed a macOS 26 scene-update loop so the main window and menu bar remain responsive. - Signed automatic app updates through Sparkle and verified yt-dlp engine updates.
